source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: A local folder can finish updateFolderAndNotifyOnLoad synchronously and enter its view before DBViewWrapper.open reaches the immediate-display path. Check folderLoading before entering again. IMAP can still load once from cache and again after the server update; this May 2024 fix did not remove that path.
title: Avoid entering a local folder twice during its initial update
